personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, rugged, terminal-like utility tool designed for harsh outdoor readability and precise agricultural data entry.

spacing.rule: Use rigid grids, edge-to-edge sections, sharp containers, and thick dividers instead of soft cards. Spacing must be dense but tap-friendly.

dont's: No blur or glass anywhere. Use solid colors and hard borders. Brutalist personality forbids glass.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Simple email/password authentication screen for field workers.

states.error: Hard red border on inputs, stark red text block below.

screens.layout: Hero image (drone over field) covering top 40% with a gradient scrim. Bottom 60% contains sharp, full-width inputs with thick 2pt borders and JetBrains Mono labels. Solid heavy green CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Entry point to start the 4 types of inspections and view recent submission history.

states.empty: Empty state clipboard illustration, 'Belum ada data inspeksi', with 'Mulai Inspeksi' CTA.
states.error: Error message in a high-contrast box with a 'Coba Lagi' button.

screens.layout: Grid of 4 stark, edge-to-edge square buttons for the forms (QUALITY CONTROL LAND CLEARING, etc.) using brandSecondary backgrounds and thick borders. Below: A dense, list of recent inspections with monospaced timestamps and statuses. No soft shadows; use 2pt separators.

screens.name: FormHeader
screens.purpose: Capture metadata for the inspection (Kebun, Afdeling, Blok, etc.).

states.error: Validation errors highlighted with sharp red borders.

screens.layout: Single column, one input per line. Labels above inputs. Dropdowns for predefined fields. Inputs have stark 2pt borders. Primary 'Lanjut ke Sampel' sticky CTA fixed at the bottom.

screens.name: FormInspection
screens.purpose: Iterative data capture for sample lines and points with segmented choices and photos.

states.error: Inline validation for missing mandatory photos or selections.

screens.layout: Chunked by 'Jalur Sampel' and 'Titik Sampel'. Use edge-to-edge segmented controls (Standar / Tidak, Sudah / Belum) instead of dropdowns for speed. High-contrast active states (color flip, no press scale). A dedicated 'Ambil Foto' button with a camera icon per item. 'Keterangan' text area below. Sticky navigation for 'Sebelumnya' and 'Selanjutnya' at the bottom.

screens.name: FormSignature
screens.purpose: Capture digital signatures of the inspector and the acknowledged party, then submit.

states.error: Signature pad bordered in red if missing.

screens.layout: Two large, rigid signature canvas boxes with 'Hapus' (Clear) text links. Solid 'Simpan & Kirim' CTA pinned at the bottom. Utilitarian and legal document-like formatting.

screens.name: HistoryDetail
screens.purpose: Review a submitted form and export it.
screens.layout: Dense, read-only metadata block at the top. Below, a grid of sample points and thumbnail photos. Fixed bottom action bar with three stark buttons: 'Export PDF', 'Export Excel', and 'Share WA'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow 5 Brutalist Mobile strictly: use rigid grids, edge-to-edge sections, sharp containers, and thick (2pt) dividers. NO BORDER RADIUS (set to 0 everywhere).
Color Palette: Use Forest Green (#15803D) as the primary brand color for CTAs and highlights. ALL BLUES ARE STRICTLY BANNED.
Typography: Use Space Grotesk for display headers and JetBrains Mono for form labels, metrics, timestamps, and input text. This enforces the 'audit/terminal' feel.
Navigation: Stick to stack_only navigation. Do not use a bottom tab bar, as the app is a linear data entry tool.
Forms: Optimize for thumb usage and speed. Use large edge-to-edge segmented controls for 'Standar / Tidak', 'Ada / Tidak' instead of dropdowns where possible.
Forms: Include 'sticky' CTAs at the bottom of scrollable views, specifically for 'Lanjut', 'Sebelumnya/Selanjutnya', and 'Simpan & Kirim'.
Signature Pad: Implement two dedicated canvas areas with explicit 'Hapus' (Clear) text buttons.
Images: Ensure text placed over the login_hero image has a gradient-to-dark scrim (top to bottom) for readability.
Shadows & Blur: Disable all shadows (shadow_tier 0) and glassmorphism. Use stark color contrast and borders to separate sections.
Ensure all text is in Bahasa Indonesia as requested.
